source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 20 august — «Sfântul Mucenic Eliodor»

attestations.note: The page doxologia's calendar links for him carries neither a Viață tab nor a Tropar tab; the calendar line is everything the source gives. The corpus keeps no Heliodorus on 20 August in any other calendar, so this folder rests on the Romanian day alone.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 20ης Αυγούστου — «Άγιοι Ηλιόδωρος και Δοσάς»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 20 Αυγούστου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries. The entry adds a companion the corpus did not keep, «Δοσάς (ή Δοσαί ή Σοδάς)», who is a new folder in the same batch and is linked from the life. saint.gr gives no year, only that the two lived under Sabor, king of the Persians, and that Heliodorus was ninety-five at the time, so no `dates` object is proposed. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page. The page prints no hymn, only one distich for the pair.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).
